biggest_catch: New workers only get the LOWEST-paying work: 8.5 cents per audio minute, and pay is per audio minute of the FILE, not your time — one audio minute can take 2-10 minutes to transcribe. Rejected work (grades 0-4) is discarded and NOT paid at all.
catches: Newcomers start at 8.5 cents per audio minute — the bottom of the range; higher-paying jobs require working up through badge levels.
Pay is per AUDIO minute of the file, not per work hour — one audio minute can take 2-10 minutes to transcribe, so effective hourly pay can be ~$1/hour at entry level.
Rejected work (grades 0-4) is discarded and redone — you get $0 for it. Grading determines your pay on every job.
Bonus multipliers only apply from grade 5 up: grade 5 = base pay, grade 9 = 3x base pay — top pay requires consistently near-perfect grades.
Zero guaranteed tasks: you pick from an available-jobs list; weekends, US holidays, and US summer months can see fewer jobs posted.
Must be 18+ and live in a supported country; must be legal to work as an independent contractor.
The '$1' catalog figure is the TOP of the official range — entry-level reality is 8.5 cents/audio minute.

c1.evidence: CastingWords — real operating US company since 2005 (founders Nathan McFarland and Rachel Pearson, Los Alamos, NM); official site castingwords.com live with customer transcription business.

c2.evidence: CastingWords' official contractor FAQ, quoted verbatim ('In their own words') in multiple independent sources: 'For transcription, the short answer is anywhere between 8.5 cents and a bit over one dollar per audio minute. Pay varies widely based on a number of factors, including what type of job you do, what level you have reached, and what grade you earn.' Concrete pay figure + mechanism stated by the company.

c3.evidence: Official contractor FAQ: 'No fees - we pay you, you don't pay us.'

c4.evidence: Weekly payouts via PayPal reported by third-party sources (Friday 10 AM Pacific); could NOT be confirmed from an official page read.

eligibility: Must be at least 18; must live in a supported country; must be able to receive the type of payments issued; must be legal to work as an independent contractor. Pass a test transcribing a short audio file to be accepted.

steps: Confirm you are 18+, live in a supported country, and can legally work as an independent contractor.
Apply on the CastingWords site and pass the transcription test (transcribe a short audio file; a failed test may or may not be retakable).
Once accepted, pick assignments from the Available Jobs list — each job shows its time allotment; click 'Work on This' to claim.
Complete and review the transcription, then submit it to CastingWords for grading.
Grading determines pay: grades 0-4 are rejected and unpaid; grade 5 earns base pay; grades 6-9 earn 1.5x to 3x base pay. Raise your badge level over time to unlock higher-paying jobs.
Get paid via PayPal (third-party sources report weekly Friday payouts).
timing: Third-party sources report weekly Friday payouts via PayPal MassPay (company covers PayPal fees); could not confirm from official pages read.
